gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.live_model: the operator's own installed, signed-in kiro-cli over ACP with model "auto"; the replies on screen are that model's and vary from run to run
agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served the personal-shopper app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/personal_shopper, website/src/apps/personal-shopper). This repository is the externally packaged copy of that app; PORTING.md lists where the two differ.
data_notes: History entries carry the date they were saved: the app stamps each entry with the gateway's own clock and its API takes no date, so every entry shows the capture day.
History was filled through POST /api/apps/personal-shopper/history. Nothing in the app's UI or the advisor writes History today, so the README shows that picture as example data.

The chat scenes ran on a live model (see agent_backend). The gateway's approval mode is 'reads', which approves web page fetches but declined the advisor's web searches, and the stores are fictional .example sites that cannot be opened, so the advisor read no store page: the prices in its replies are its own rough guesses, as it says.
